login.subtitle: Sign in to the back office

locked.title: System locked – insecure configuration
locked.intro: This installation runs in production mode, but some secrets still contain example values or are too weak. Until this is fixed, the system stays inactive: no logins, no API, no notifications.
locked.howto: Please use strong, unique passwords in .env and restart the container:
locked.inactive: Values are never shown here. The check runs at every start.

problem.placeholder: still contains the example value from .env.example

customers.pin_hint: Drag the pin to correct the delivery point.
customers.pin_missing: No coordinates yet – saved addresses are geocoded automatically, or use the search.
customers.geocode_failed: Saved, but the address could not be found on the map. Please use the address search or set the pin.
customers.indicator_hint: EAN-8 composite (ISO/IEC 24723): customer number as barcode, name in the 2D part.
customers.confirm_delete: Delete this customer? Customers with orders are deactivated instead.

products.name: Name

orders.title: Orders
orders.customer_search: Search customer by name, number, address …
orders.no_items: No items – add products or free items.

tours.title: Tours
tours.name: Name
tours.missing_coords: {n} stop(s) without coordinates – fix the address in the address book.
tours.released: Tour released – the driver sees it in the app.
tours.confirm_finish: Close the tour? Open stops count as skipped and their orders become open again.
tours.confirm_delete: Delete tour? Its orders become open again.
tours.fix_hint: Pin to this position when re-optimizing
tours.no_open_orders: No open orders for this date.

settings.title: Settings
settings.depot_hint: Default start and end of new tours.
settings.barcodes_hint: Each order gets an EAN-13 delivery code for labels and scanning in the app.
settings.barcode_per_delivery_hint: a new code for every order
settings.barcode_per_customer_hint: the same code on every delivery of a customer (reusable crates/labels)
settings.ean_prefix_hint: 20–29: GS1 range for internal use (restricted circulation). Can be overridden per customer.
settings.indicator_hint: Customer indicator: EAN-8 composite with the customer number (7 digits + check digit) and the name in the 2D component (umlauts are encoded GS1-compliant).
settings.channels_hint: Channels are configured in .env (SMTP_*, WHATSAPP_PROVIDER …), see docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md.
settings.lead_stops_hint: When a customer is among the next {n} open stops, the live tracking is activated and the "approaching" message is sent.
settings.auto_day_start: At tour start: message to all other customers of the day
settings.subject: Subject (e-mail)
settings.whatsapp_template_hint: WhatsApp: business-initiated messages need a template approved by Meta/Twilio with the variables 1 = name, 2 = ETA, 3 = link. Without template the text above is sent (only within 24 h after the customer wrote to you).
settings.outcomes_hint: Outcomes are the buttons in the driver app. Add your own, set required proofs and freely extend the reasons.
settings.final_hint: Non-final or neutral outcomes are only logged; the stop stays open.
settings.confirm_delete_outcome: Delete outcome? Used outcomes are deactivated instead.
settings.scan_accept: Barcode scan accepted as proof of delivery
settings.scan_accept_customer: Only the customer barcode (EAN-8+C at the customer)
settings.scan_accept_hint: Print the one-page customer barcode once (address book or tour) and leave it at the customer – then no new label per order is needed. Enable "Barcode scan" as requirement for the outcomes under Outcomes & reasons.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Drivers sign in to the app with their personal QR code
team.code_hidden: Code active – only visible to admins
team.confirm_regenerate: Generate a new code for "{name}"? The current one becomes invalid and devices are signed out.
team.confirm_revoke: Revoke the code of "{name}"? Printed codes stop working.
team.confirm_delete: Delete "{name}" permanently? Tours and the delivery log keep their history.
team.create_hint: Without password the member only signs in to the app with the login code, which is generated right away. Dispatchers and admins need a password for the back office.

labels.customer_sheet_hint_2: Our driver scans this code to confirm each delivery.

tracking.active_title: We are on the way to you
tracking.failed_hint: We will contact you to arrange a new date.
